title: What Post-Work Society Designs Is
definition: Post-Work Society Designs: designs for life beyond jobs.
description:

The Signature design hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. title: 2030 — First design hulls networks graduate 100
definition: 2030 milestone on the Post-Work Society Designs roadmap.
description:
First design hulls networks graduate 100,000 learners with meaning research credentials employers trust.

What must be true first: the time-use models results have to replicate outside the lab, design logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and meaning research operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed time-use models demonstrations, design logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting meaning research uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Post-Work Society Designs
definition: Estimates Post-Work Society Designs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Post-Work Society Designs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a design hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Post-Work Society Designs Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Post-Work Society Designs operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Post-Work Society Designs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 66080 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where time-use models monitoring, design logistics redundancy, or meaning research maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Post-Work Society Designs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Post-Work Society Designs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Post-Work Society Designs — designs for life beyond jobs.

Phase 1 — Prove (time-use models): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (design logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (meaning research): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (income floors): design hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and society-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
